Adapter gate.condition: Adapter gate ablation is worse than full model for every controlled row

CATO alignment diagnostics.condition: CATO alignment diagnostics are present and improve on the CATO controlled family

CATO collapse.condition: CATO true-router + learned-adapter loss <= specialist * 1.05 + eps

LRIO collapse.condition: LRIO true-router + learned-adapter loss <= specialist * 1.05 + eps

Memory gate.condition: Memory gate ablation is worse than full model for every controlled row

RCEO gate.condition: reliability decreases with corruption, router load shifts coherently, and RCEO prior improves loss

Router decomposition ablations.condition: router logit decomposition ablations must degrade: no-evidence, no-reliability, memory-only, evidence-only

SPO collapse.condition: SPO true-router + learned-adapter loss <= specialist * 1.05 + eps

Stackability.condition: all candidate values are [B,Q,Dy] and stackability_passed is explicit true

TLEO collapse.condition: TLEO true-router + learned-adapter loss <= specialist * 1.05 + eps

no-LRIO ablation.condition: no-LRIO ablation is worse than full model on targeted sentiment-entry controlled families

no-RCEO ablation.condition: no-RCEO ablation is worse than full model on targeted sentiment-entry controlled families

stage_history.policy: controlled synthetic in-memory batch generation validated before optimizer stages
